deskew_scope: rotation_only with calibrated rotational lever-arm component; no platform translation

metric.name: same-identity midpoint-selected dominant-plane orthogonal residual
metric.selection_bias_control: RANSAC selects IDs on (raw + deskew) / 2, invariant to swapping treatment labels; raw and deskew fits use identical point IDs
metric.point_prefilter: finite nonzero points with 0.5 <= range <= 15.0 m
metric.acceptance: at least 500 plane IDs, at least 80 percent point-time span, and at least 25 IDs in every time quartile

high_rotation.selection: top 80 IMU-covered scans by integral abs(omega) dt

low_rotation_control.selection: bottom 80 IMU-covered scans by integral abs(omega) dt

lever_arm_ablation.selection: identical point IDs selected on (raw + no_lever + lever) / 3

verdict: Rotation-only deskew with the calibrated IMU lever arm materially reduces motion-thickened planes during real rotation and leaves low-rotation scans unchanged. It does not claim platform-translation or full 6DoF compensation.
